summary: Rewrite through arrowTensor: the right side becomes the zero term of the triple Weil action; the translation by stackedTFin commutes with the actions because the frequency maps are invariant.

steps.claim: The right side is leftInverse(arrowTensor((ω_a(g, g′) ⊗ ω_b(g′, k′))finEval(Φ ⊠ Φ′))) = leftInverse(tripleWeil(a, b)((1, g), (1, g′), (1, k′))·zeroTermFin(ϱ_f(stackedTFin)(Φ ⊠ Φ′))) (leftInverse_arrowTensor, arrowTensor_map_liftWeilFin, arrowTensor_finEval), and by e and zeroTerm_splitting_tripleWeil this is the left inverse of the zero term of the triple Weil action of the included points; it is used that tripleWeil commutes with ⊗ v (left as a goal).
steps.lean:
erw [← hx, ← leftInverse_arrowTensor (.map _ _ _), arrowTensor_map_liftWeilFin,
    arrowTensor_finEval, ← e, ← D.zeroTerm_splitting_tripleWeil,
    (?_ : Function.Commute (tripleWeil ..) (integrated _ _))]

steps.claim: Unfolding finEval and zeroTermFin, it remains to move the translation ϱ_f(stackedTFin) through the twisted Weil operators.
steps.lean:
simp [finEval, zeroTermFin, finHeisOp, show finVec (stackedTFin Y Y' Y'') =
    V'.homAtPoint (flipSum V V'') (fromRows (V.formAdjoint V' (((0, 1) :
    𝔸 E) • Y.stringMap Y')) (((0, 1) : 𝔸 E) • Y'.stringMap Y'')) by ext <;> simp [finVec,
    stackedTFin, homAtPoint, matToVec, stackedT, formAdjoint,
    Prod.fst_sum, Prod.snd_sum], homHeisOp_arrowProduct, ← arrowProduct_twistedPairWeil,
    pairWeil_homHeisOp, inclX_mul_stringMap_mul_inclX_inv, -ratCoordMatrix_inclX, ← inclX_inr]

steps.claim: The finite vector of stackedTFin is homAtPoint of fromRows(α_f·T*, α_f·T′): the point of Hom(V′, V⁻ ⊕ V″) given by the finite parts of the two frequency maps (entrywise).
steps.lean:
show finVec (stackedTFin Y Y' Y'') =
    V'.homAtPoint (flipSum V V'') (fromRows (V.formAdjoint V' (((0, 1) :
    𝔸 E) • Y.stringMap Y')) (((0, 1) : 𝔸 E) • Y'.stringMap Y'')) by ext <;> simp [finVec,
    stackedTFin, homAtPoint, matToVec, stackedT, formAdjoint,
    Prod.fst_sum, Prod.snd_sum]

steps.claim: The Heisenberg translation of an arrow product is the arrow product of translations (homHeisOp_arrowProduct), arrow products intertwine twisted pair Weil operators with tripleWeil (arrowProduct_twistedPairWeil), and translation by T commutes with the pair action because T is U(X) × U(X′)-invariant (pairWeil_homHeisOp, inclX_mul_stringMap_mul_inclX_inv).
The postponed goal: tripleWeil(a, b) at points with trivial real component commutes with v ⊗ · (omega_integrated).
